run_train_job: run a distributed training job on a SLURM cluster using submitit with 8 GPUs per node
create_trainer: create a Trainer instance with parsed args to submit a distributed training job via submitit
build_checkpoint_resume: build a checkpoint mechanism that resumes training from checkpoint.pth on requeue
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU args including local rank, global rank, world size, and output directory from submitit job environment
submit_training_job: submit a training job to SLURM with configurable memory, GPUs, CPUs, partition, and timeout
